utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re keeping the Saturday porch repair drive tight and low-friction, and I can help sort what still needs covering. Just tell me what you want me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please bring the screwdriver and gloves, and be on the front porch at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’m keeping it simple and hoping we can get the porch sorted with a few steady hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, I can be there for a while. Just remind me what you want me to bring on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll do the same and keep everyone posted if anything changes before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit worried we’re light on hands, so let’s keep Saturday focused. Tell me what still needs covering and I’ll help narrow the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Pia. I’ll confirm who’s coming and keep Saturday focused on the porch work so we only tackle what we can finish.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll be at the porch Saturday with the tools and we can see who shows up to help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli, but the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll confirm the time and bring the updated list so we can keep everyone in sync.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam, that help would be appreciated. I’ll send along any Saturday updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess. I’ll be ready Saturday and keep an eye out for your updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need tools kept in order and someone at the door to greet people when they arrive. If those are covered, I can help keep the Saturday plan tight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can take the door and keep folks moving in, and I’ll repeat the Saturday porch repair plan to anyone who asks so we stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I’ll count on you being there at 9. Bring the screwdriver and gloves, and I’ll have the rest ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll be there at 9 with the screwdriver and gloves. Just point me to where you want me to start.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
